intro.en: In the Foundry portal you create a project, deploy a model from the catalog, test it in the playground, evaluate it and protect it with guardrails.
intro.ro: Foundry portal mein aap project banate hain, catalog se model deploy karte hain, playground mein test, evaluation aur guardrails se hifazat karte hain.

text.en: The resource holds deployments and settings; projects organize the work of a team in it.
text.ro: Resource mein deployments aur settings hoti hain; projects us mein team ka kaam munazzam karte hain.

text.en: Search, filter and compare models, read model cards and benchmarks.
text.ro: Models talash, filter aur muqabla karein, model cards aur benchmarks dekhein.

text.en: A model with a name, type, version and tokens-per-minute capacity. Apps call the name.
text.ro: Model jis ka naam, type, version aur tokens-per-minute capacity hoti hai. Apps naam call karti hain.

text.en: Try prompts, parameters and files, then view the sample code.
text.ro: Prompts, parameters aur files azmayein, phir sample code dekhein.

text.en: Measures quality (such as groundedness, relevance) and safety over a dataset.
text.ro: Dataset par quality (jaise groundedness, relevance) aur safety naapta hai.

text.en: Content filters, Prompt Shields, blocklists and protected-material checks for input and output.
text.ro: Input aur output ke liye content filters, Prompt Shields, blocklists aur protected material ki jaanch.

text.en: Foundry User (formerly Azure AI User) is enough to build and call; managing resources needs more.
text.ro: Banane aur call karne ke liye Foundry User (pehle Azure AI User) kaafi hai; resources sambhalne ko zyada chahiye.

title.en: Example: deploy from the command line

text.en: The portal and the CLI create the same deployment. Capacity 20 means 20,000 tokens per minute.
text.ro: Portal aur CLI ek hi deployment banate hain. Capacity 20 ka matlab fi minute 20,000 tokens.

example.code:
az cognitiveservices account deployment create \
  --resource-group rg-ai901 --name contoso-ai \
  --deployment-name chat-prod \
  --model-name gpt-5-mini --model-version 2025-08-07 \
  --model-format OpenAI \
  --sku-name GlobalStandard --sku-capacity 20

rows.en: Good in the playground, unknown over many cases
rows.ro: Playground mein acha, bohat cases mein na maloom

remember.en: One model can have several deployments with different names and types.
remember.ro: Ek model ki mukhtalif naam aur type ki kai deployments ho sakti hain.

remember.en: After a model version change, evaluate again.
remember.ro: Model version badalne ke baad dobara evaluate karein.

remember.en: A playground test is a first look and not an evaluation.
remember.ro: Playground ka test pehli nazar hai, evaluation nahi.

remember.en: Delete unused deployments and resource groups to stop costs.
remember.ro: Kharcha rokne ke liye ghair zaroori deployments aur resource groups delete karein.

traps.en: The deployment name and the model name can differ; code uses the deployment name.
traps.ro: Deployment ka naam aur model ka naam mukhtalif ho sakte hain; code deployment ka naam istemal karta hai.

traps.en: Groundedness checks whether the answer follows the source, not whether the source is true.
traps.ro: Groundedness dekhta hai ke jawab source ke mutabiq hai, ye nahi ke source sach hai.
